label: Jeffrey Epstein born
note: The OIG report gives his birth year as 1953. Only the year is established by this source; January 1 is a sorting placeholder.

sources.title: DOJ OIG, report 23-085 (June 2023), executive summary and p. 5

label: Palm Beach police investigation begins
note: Palm Beach police began investigating after a complaint involving a minor. Only the year is specified here.

label: Federal non-prosecution agreement signed
note: The Southern District of Florida agreed to forgo federal prosecution under an agreement requiring a state plea and other conditions.

label: Florida guilty plea and sentence
note: Epstein pleaded guilty to felony solicitation of prostitution and procurement of minors to engage in prostitution. He received 18 months in county jail, followed by community control.

label: Arrest at Teterboro Airport
note: Federal authorities arrested Epstein upon his return to the United States.

sources.title: DOJ OIG, report 23-085 (June 2023), executive summary and p. 5

label: SDNY indictment unsealed
note: Epstein was charged with sex trafficking of minors and conspiracy. The indictment was an accusation, not a conviction.

label: Death in federal custody
note: Epstein was found unresponsive at MCC New York and pronounced dead at a hospital. The medical examiner determined the death was suicide.

sources.title: DOJ OIG, report 23-085 (June 2023), executive summary and p. 5

label: Maxwell arrested
note: Ghislaine Maxwell was arrested and charged in a federal case concerning alleged abuse of minors and alleged perjury.

label: DOJ reviews Florida resolution
note: OPR published its executive summary examining the federal investigation, non-prosecution agreement and treatment of victims. Source specifies November 2020.

label: Maxwell convicted
note: A federal jury found Maxwell guilty of five offenses, including sex trafficking of a minor.

label: Maxwell sentenced
note: Maxwell was sentenced to 20 years in federal prison.

label: Inspector General report
note: OIG documented serious failures in custody and supervision. It found no evidence contradicting the FBI’s determination that there was no criminality associated with the death. Source specifies June 2023.

sources.title: DOJ OIG, report 23-085 (June 2023), executive summary and p. 5

label: Civil-record unsealing order
note: The court issued findings following a particularized review and allowed time for affected people to appeal.

label: January unsealing begins
note: The court said filing would begin that day, with exceptions under review. The accompanying notice described rolling releases.

label: Privacy correction ordered
note: The court directed that five attachments be stricken and refiled with personal identifying information redacted.

label: Final set under December order filed
note: The filing notice described this as the last set pursuant to the December 18 order, with specified exceptions still under review.

label: DOJ announces major records release
note: DOJ announced over three million additional pages under the Epstein Files Transparency Act. Publication of a record does not establish the truth of its contents.

label: DOJ library update
note: The library displayed this as its last-updated date when checked on October 30, 2026. This is a website update, not a court finding.
